title: Dielectric
doc: The non-metal family: full physical specular at IOR 1.5, mid roughness, a mid grey albedo.

provenance.note: specular_ior 1.5, the index of common soda-lime glass, the usual dielectric reference
base_metalness 0 by definition of the family; specular_weight 1 is the physical amount at the IOR, written so the family reads; specular_roughness 0.5 and base_color 0.5 chosen as mid values
